trimmingSuggestions.description: Remove repetition in the visuals. The split-screen effectively demonstrates the LORA's effect, but showing the same pose throughout the entire video makes it visually repetitive. Introducing more dynamic visuals, even if it's just showcasing various generated images with varying details, could significantly enhance the video's dynamism.
Shorten the call to action. While encouraging engagement is essential, the call to action could be condensed to maintain a better flow and avoid redundancy.
